reports.title: Dòng phiếu xuất kho bán hàng
reports.join: ph81.stt_rec = ct81.stt_rec; line key stt_rec + ln
reports.tool_description: Đọc chi tiết và tổng hợp dòng phiếu xuất kho bán hàng (ph81/ct81). BẮT BUỘC có mã vật tư (material) và khoảng ngày ISO (tối đa 31 ngày). Chỉ dùng cho xuất kho bán hàng; KHÔNG dùng cho tồn kho, BOM, bảng giá/MOQ, QC, đơn hàng hay master khách hàng. Sử dụng trường summary trong kết quả để lấy tổng số lượng và số dòng toàn kỳ.
reports.status_message: Đang tra cứu dữ liệu xuất bán...

presentation.title: Bảng kê phiếu xuất kho bán hàng
presentation.empty_text: Không có phiếu xuất kho bán hàng cho {scope}.

reports.title: Danh mục bảng giá và MOQ
reports.tool_description: Tra cứu bảng giá, giá bán hiện tại và MOQ (số lượng đặt tối thiểu sl_min) theo mã vật tư (material) và ngày tham chiếu (date_as_of định dạng YYYY-MM-DD).
reports.status_message: Đang tra cứu bảng giá & MOQ...

reports.title: Cấu trúc sản phẩm và định mức BOM
reports.tool_description: Tra cứu cấu trúc sản phẩm BOM, định mức nguyên vật liệu và loại nhựa theo mã sản phẩm mẹ (material) và ngày tham chiếu (date_as_of định dạng YYYY-MM-DD).
reports.status_message: Đang tra cứu định mức BOM & nhựa...

reports.title: Danh mục khách hàng
reports.tool_description: Tra cứu danh mục khách hàng/đối tác theo mã hoặc tên (query_text).
reports.status_message: Đang tra cứu danh mục khách hàng...

reports.title: Danh mục nhân viên và tài khoản ERP
reports.tool_description: Chỉ dùng tra cứu mã nhân viên công ty (dmkh nv_yn=1) hoặc username đăng nhập ERP (userinfo) theo tên có/không dấu, mã NV hoặc username (query_text) — KHÔNG dùng cho tài khoản kế toán (131, 331...) hay khách hàng (KH...).
reports.next_step_note: Đây mới là danh mục nhân viên/tài khoản ERP. Nếu câu hỏi gắn với chứng từ nghiệp vụ (như phiếu đề nghị mua, đơn đặt mua...), hãy gọi tiếp query_semantic_plan với tập dữ liệu phù hợp trước khi kết luận.
reports.status_message: Đang tra cứu danh mục nhân viên & tài khoản ERP...

reports.title: Khách hàng khai báo trên mã vật tư
reports.tool_description: Tra khách hàng ĐƯỢC KHAI BÁO trên mã hàng/vật tư (material) từ dmvt.ma_kh. Dùng khi hỏi mã hàng thuộc khách nào; không dùng query_customer_info.
reports.status_message: Đang tra khách hàng khai báo trên mã vật tư...

reports.title: Báo cáo tồn kho sổ sách
reports.tool_description: Tra cứu số lượng tồn kho sổ sách của mã vật tư (material) tính đến ngày tham chiếu (date_as_of định dạng YYYY-MM-DD).
reports.status_message: Đang tra cứu tồn kho sổ sách...

reports.title: Tồn kho sổ sách theo từng kho
reports.join: cdvt union all ct70, grouped by ma_kho
reports.tool_description: Tra tồn kho sổ sách của mã vật tư (material) THEO TỪNG KHO tại ngày tham chiếu (date_as_of). Dùng khi người dùng hỏi 'ở từng kho', 'theo kho', hoặc 'kho nào bao nhiêu'.
reports.status_message: Đang tra cứu tồn kho theo từng kho...

presentation.title: Báo cáo tồn kho theo từng kho
presentation.empty_text: Không tìm thấy số dư tồn kho theo kho cho {scope}.

reports.title: Hồ sơ thiết bị khuôn và tuổi thọ shot

sales_delivery_lines.title: Tổng hợp xuất kho bán hàng (HDA: ph81/ct81)
sales_delivery_lines.source_sql: SELECT h.ma_kh AS customer, coalesce(k.ten_kh, '') AS customer_name, d.ma_vt AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, d.ma_kho AS warehouse, trim(coalesce(h.ma_nt, '')) AS currency, h.ngay_ct AS day, coalesce(d.dvt, v.dvt, '') AS unit, d.so_luong AS quantity, d.tien2 AS revenue_vnd, d.tien_nt2 AS revenue_orig, h.stt_rec AS doc_id FROM public.ph81 h JOIN public.ct81 d ON d.stt_rec = h.stt_rec LEFT JOIN public.dmkh k ON k.ma_kh = h.ma_kh LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = d.ma_vt JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE h.ma_gd <> 4 AND h.status::text IN ('1', '2') AND (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR (h.ma_dvcs = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')) AND (coalesce(u.ds_stocks, '') = '' OR d.ma_kho = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_stocks, ''), ',')))))

sales_order_lines.title: Tổng hợp đơn đặt hàng bán (SO1: ph64/ct64)
sales_order_lines.source_sql: SELECT h.ma_kh AS customer, coalesce(k.ten_kh, '') AS customer_name, d.ma_vt AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, d.ma_kho AS warehouse, trim(coalesce(h.ma_nt, '')) AS currency, h.ngay_ct AS day, coalesce(d.dvt, v.dvt, '') AS unit, d.so_luong AS quantity, d.tien2 AS amount_vnd, d.tien_nt2 AS amount_orig, h.stt_rec AS doc_id FROM public.ph64 h JOIN public.ct64 d ON d.stt_rec = h.stt_rec LEFT JOIN public.dmkh k ON k.ma_kh = h.ma_kh LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = d.ma_vt JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE h.status::text NOT IN ('0', '14', '15') AND (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR h.ma_dvcs = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')))

purchase_order_lines.title: Tổng hợp đơn đặt hàng mua (PO1: ph94/ct94)
purchase_order_lines.notes: day (ngay_ct) là Ngày lập đơn PO; required_date (ct94.ngay_yc) là Ngày nhận hàng yêu cầu. Mã nhân viên (dmkh) lọc theo 'requester' hoặc 'in_charge'; username đăng nhập ERP lọc theo 'creator_user'.
purchase_order_lines.source_sql: SELECT h.so_ct AS po_no, h.ma_kh AS supplier, coalesce(k.ten_kh, '') AS supplier_name, coalesce(h.ma_bp, '') AS department, coalesce(h.ma_nvbh, '') AS requester, coalesce(req.ten_kh, '') AS requester_name, coalesce(h.nguoi_phu_trach, '') AS in_charge, coalesce(pic.ten_kh, '') AS in_charge_name, coalesce(cr.user_name, '') AS creator_user, coalesce(cr.ten, '') AS creator_name, d.ma_vt AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, d.ma_kho AS warehouse, trim(coalesce(h.ma_nt, '')) AS currency, h.ngay_ct AS day, d.ngay_yc AS required_date, coalesce(d.dvt, v.dvt, '') AS unit, d.so_luong AS quantity, d.tien AS amount_vnd, d.tien_nt AS amount_orig, d.gia AS unit_price_vnd, h.stt_rec AS doc_id FROM public.ph94 h JOIN public.ct94 d ON d.stt_rec = h.stt_rec LEFT JOIN public.dmkh k ON k.ma_kh = h.ma_kh LEFT JOIN public.dmkh req ON req.ma_kh = h.ma_nvbh LEFT JOIN public.dmkh pic ON pic.ma_kh = h.nguoi_phu_trach LEFT JOIN public.userinfo cr ON cr.user_id = h.user_id0 LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = d.ma_vt JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE h.status::text NOT IN ('0', '14', '15') AND (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR h.ma_dvcs = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')))

purchase_requests.title: Tổng hợp phiếu yêu cầu / đề nghị mua hàng (PR0: ph91/ct91)
purchase_requests.notes: day (ngay_ct) là Ngày lập phiếu; required_date (ct91.ngay_yc) là Ngày nhận hàng yêu cầu. Mã nhân viên (dmkh) lọc theo trường 'requester'; username đăng nhập ERP lọc theo 'creator_user'.
purchase_requests.source_sql: SELECT h.so_ct AS pr_no, h.ngay_ct AS day, d.ngay_yc AS required_date, coalesce(h.ma_bp, d.ma_bp, '') AS department, coalesce(h.ma_nv, '') AS requester, coalesce(req.ten_kh, '') AS requester_name, coalesce(cr.user_name, '') AS creator_user, coalesce(cr.ten, '') AS creator_name, d.ma_vt AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, coalesce(d.dvt, v.dvt, '') AS unit, d.ma_kho AS warehouse, trim(coalesce(h.status::text, '')) AS status, d.so_luong AS quantity, h.stt_rec AS doc_id FROM public.ph91 h JOIN public.ct91 d ON d.stt_rec = h.stt_rec LEFT JOIN public.dmkh req ON req.ma_kh = h.ma_nv LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = d.ma_vt LEFT JOIN public.userinfo cr ON cr.user_id = h.user_id0 JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE h.status::text NOT IN ('0', '14', '15') AND (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR h.ma_dvcs = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')))

purchase_receipt_lines.title: Tổng hợp phiếu nhập mua hàng từ NCC (PR1: ph77/ct77)
purchase_receipt_lines.source_sql: SELECT h.ma_kh AS supplier, coalesce(k.ten_kh, '') AS supplier_name, d.ma_vt AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, d.ma_kho AS warehouse, trim(coalesce(h.ma_nt, '')) AS currency, h.ngay_ct AS day, coalesce(d.dvt, v.dvt, '') AS unit, d.so_luong AS quantity, d.tien AS amount_vnd, d.tien_nt AS amount_orig, h.stt_rec AS doc_id FROM public.ph77 h JOIN public.ct77 d ON d.stt_rec = h.stt_rec LEFT JOIN public.dmkh k ON k.ma_kh = h.ma_kh LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = d.ma_vt JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE h.status::text IN ('1', '11', '12') AND (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR (h.ma_dvcs = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')) AND (coalesce(u.ds_stocks, '') = '' OR d.ma_kho = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_stocks, ''), ',')))))

inventory_movements.title: Tổng hợp phát sinh nhập xuất kho trong kỳ (ct70)
inventory_movements.source_sql: SELECT c.ma_kho AS warehouse, coalesce(w.ten_kho, '') AS warehouse_name, c.ma_vt AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, coalesce(c.dvt, v.dvt, '') AS unit, trim(coalesce(c.ma_ct, '')) AS doc_type, c.ngay_ct AS day, c.sl_nhap AS in_qty, c.sl_xuat AS out_qty, c.tien_nhap AS in_amount_vnd, c.tien_xuat AS out_amount_vnd, c.stt_rec AS doc_id FROM public.ct70 c LEFT JOIN public.dmkho w ON w.ma_kho = c.ma_kho LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = c.ma_vt JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE (c.ma_ct NOT IN ('PXB', 'PNF') OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.ph85 b WHERE c.so_ct = b.so_ct AND b.ma_kho = b.ma_khon)) AND (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR (coalesce(u.ds_stocks, '') = '' OR c.ma_kho = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_stocks, ''), ','))))

mes_downtime_lines.title: Thống kê dừng máy / dừng chuyền MES (mes_oi_stop_line)
mes_downtime_lines.source_sql: SELECT a.machine_code AS machine, coalesce(a.error_code, '') AS reason_code, coalesce(d.ten_loi, '') AS reason_name, coalesce(d.nh_nndungmay1, '') AS reason_group, a.create_date AS day, round((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (a.end_date::timestamp + a.end_time::time - a.create_date::timestamp - a.create_time::time)) / 60.0)::numeric, 2) AS stop_minutes, a.id AS event_id FROM public.mes_oi_stop_line a LEFT JOIN public.dmnndungmay d ON d.ma_loi = a.error_code CROSS JOIN public.userinfo u WHERE u.user_id = %s AND a.end_date IS NOT NULL AND a.end_date >= a.create_date AND a.end_date > '1900-01-01'

mes_ng_defects.title: Thống kê phế phẩm / lỗi sản xuất NG MES (mes_oi_ng_confirm)
mes_ng_defects.source_sql: SELECT a.machine_code AS machine, a.product_code AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, coalesce(a.error_code, '') AS defect_code, coalesce(l.ten_loi, '') AS defect_name, a.create_date AS day, coalesce(a.ng_qty, 0) AS ng_qty, a.id_oi_ng AS record_id FROM public.mes_oi_ng_confirm a LEFT JOIN public.dmloi l ON l.ma_loi = a.error_code LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = a.product_code CROSS JOIN public.userinfo u WHERE u.user_id = %s

qc_iqc_lines.title: Thống kê kiểm tra chất lượng hàng mua IQC (phiqc)
qc_iqc_lines.source_sql: SELECT h.ma_ncc AS supplier, coalesce(k.ten_kh, '') AS supplier_name, h.ma_vt AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, h.ngay_ct AS day, coalesce(h.ket_qua::text, '') AS qc_result, coalesce(h.so_luong, 0) AS lot_qty, coalesce(h.so_luong_ok, 0) AS ok_qty, coalesce(h.so_luong_ng, 0) AS ng_qty, h.stt_rec AS doc_id FROM public.phiqc h LEFT JOIN public.dmkh k ON k.ma_kh = h.ma_ncc LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = h.ma_vt JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE h.status::text <> '15' AND (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR h.ma_dvcs = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')))

mes_production_output.title: Sản lượng sản xuất MES theo máy, ca, lệnh SX (mes_oi_confirm)
mes_production_output.source_sql: SELECT a.machine_code AS machine, coalesce(l.line_group_code3, '') AS line_group, CASE WHEN a.create_time >= TIME '08:00:00' AND a.create_time < TIME '20:00:00' THEN 'Ca ngày (08-20h)' ELSE 'Ca đêm (20-08h)' END AS shift, coalesce(a.production_order, '') AS work_order, a.product_code AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, coalesce(a.step_code, '') AS step, coalesce(a.station_code, '') AS station, a.create_date AS day, coalesce(v.dvt, 'PCS') AS unit, coalesce(a.quantity, 0) AS planned_qty, coalesce(a.complete, 0) AS complete_qty, coalesce(a.packing, 0) AS packing_qty, coalesce(a.ng, 0) AS ng_qty, coalesce(a.skip_shot, 0) AS skip_shot, CASE WHEN a.end_date IS NOT NULL AND a.end_date >= a.create_date AND a.end_date > '1900-01-01' THEN round((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (a.end_date::timestamp + a.end_time::time - a.create_date::timestamp - a.create_time::time)) / 60.0)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END AS run_minutes, a.id_oi AS run_id FROM public.mes_oi_confirm a LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = a.product_code LEFT JOIN public.mflist_line l ON l.line_code = a.machine_code JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR coalesce(u.ds_branchs, '') = '' OR coalesce(a.branch_code, '001') = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')))

mes_work_orders.title: Lệnh sản xuất và tiến độ kế hoạch WO (mes_scheduling_output)
mes_work_orders.source_sql: SELECT a.machine_code AS machine, coalesce(a.production_order, '') AS work_order, a.mes_scheduling_code AS schedule_code, a.product_code AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, coalesce(a.mold_code, '') AS mold, coalesce(s.statusname, a.status_wo::text, '') AS wo_status, coalesce(a.work_center_code, b.work_center_code, '') AS work_center, a.start_date AS day, coalesce(a.uom, v.dvt, 'PCS') AS unit, coalesce(a.quantity, 0) AS planned_qty, a.cavity AS cavity, a.cycle_time AS cycle_time, a.efficiency AS efficiency FROM public.mes_scheduling_output a LEFT JOIN public.mes_scheduling b ON b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = a.product_code LEFT JOIN public.sys_dmtt s ON s.ma_ct = 'WOMS' AND s.status = a.status_wo JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR coalesce(u.ds_branchs, '') = '' OR coalesce(b.ma_dvcs, '001') = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')))

mes_oee_daily.title: Hiệu suất vận hành & OEE theo máy (theo logic mesbcoee)
mes_oee_daily.notes: Chỉ số OEE tính cho máy có khai báo cycle_time và cavity; máy lắp ráp không có cycle_time trả NULL (chưa đủ căn cứ tính OEE).
mes_oee_daily.source_sql: SELECT r.machine_code AS machine, coalesce(l.line_group_code3, '') AS line_group, r.day, round(r.run_minutes::numeric, 2) AS run_minutes, round(coalesce(st.stop_minutes, 0)::numeric, 2) AS stop_minutes, round(GREATEST(r.run_minutes - coalesce(st.stop_minutes, 0), 0)::numeric, 2) AS net_minutes, round((r.ok_minutes + r.ng_minutes)::numeric, 2) AS standard_minutes, r.ok_qty, r.ng_qty, round((CASE WHEN r.run_minutes > 0 THEN GREATEST(r.run_minutes - coalesce(st.stop_minutes, 0), 0) * 100.0 / r.run_minutes END)::numeric, 2) AS availability_pct, round((CASE WHEN GREATEST(r.run_minutes - coalesce(st.stop_minutes, 0), 0) > 0 AND (r.ok_minutes + r.ng_minutes + r.skip_minutes) > 0 THEN LEAST(100.0, (r.ok_minutes + r.ng_minutes + r.skip_minutes) * 100.0 / GREATEST(r.run_minutes - coalesce(st.stop_minutes, 0), 0)) END)::numeric, 2) AS performance_pct, round((CASE WHEN (r.ok_qty + r.ng_qty) > 0 THEN r.ok_qty * 100.0 / (r.ok_qty + r.ng_qty) END)::numeric, 2) AS quality_pct, round((CASE WHEN r.run_minutes > 0 AND GREATEST(r.run_minutes - coalesce(st.stop_minutes, 0), 0) > 0 AND (r.ok_qty + r.ng_qty) > 0 AND (r.ok_minutes + r.ng_minutes + r.skip_minutes) > 0 THEN (GREATEST(r.run_minutes - coalesce(st.stop_minutes, 0), 0) * 100.0 / r.run_minutes) * LEAST(100.0, (r.ok_minutes + r.ng_minutes + r.skip_minutes) * 100.0 / GREATEST(r.run_minutes - coalesce(st.stop_minutes, 0), 0)) * (r.ok_qty * 100.0 / (r.ok_qty + r.ng_qty)) / 10000.0 END)::numeric, 2) AS oee_pct, 1::int AS line_days FROM (SELECT a.machine_code, a.create_date AS day, sum(coalesce(a.complete, 0)) AS ok_qty, sum(coalesce(a.ng, 0)) AS ng_qty, sum(CASE WHEN a.end_date IS NOT NULL AND a.end_date >= a.create_date AND a.end_date > '1900-01-01' THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (a.end_date::timestamp + a.end_time::time - a.create_date::timestamp - a.create_time::time)) / 60.0 ELSE 0 END) AS run_minutes, sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(k.cavity, s.cavity, 0) > 0 AND coalesce(NULLIF(a.cycle_plan, 0), s.cycle_time, k.chu_ki, 0) > 0 THEN coalesce(a.complete, 0) * coalesce(NULLIF(a.cycle_plan, 0), s.cycle_time, k.chu_ki, 0) / coalesce(k.cavity, s.cavity) / 60.0 ELSE 0 END) AS ok_minutes, sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(k.cavity, s.cavity, 0) > 0 AND coalesce(NULLIF(a.cycle_plan, 0), s.cycle_time, k.chu_ki, 0) > 0 THEN coalesce(a.ng, 0) * coalesce(NULLIF(a.cycle_plan, 0), s.cycle_time, k.chu_ki, 0) / coalesce(k.cavity, s.cavity) / 60.0 ELSE 0 END) AS ng_minutes, sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(k.cavity, s.cavity, 0) > 0 AND coalesce(NULLIF(a.cycle_plan, 0), s.cycle_time, k.chu_ki, 0) > 0 THEN coalesce(a.skip_shot, 0) * coalesce(NULLIF(a.cycle_plan, 0), s.cycle_time, k.chu_ki, 0) / coalesce(k.cavity, s.cavity) / 60.0 ELSE 0 END) AS skip_minutes FROM public.mes_oi_confirm a LEFT JOIN public.mes_scheduling_output s ON s.mes_scheduling_code = a.mes_scheduling_code AND s.product_code = a.product_code LEFT JOIN public.dmhosokhuonsp k ON k.ma_khuon = s.mold_code AND k.ma_sp = a.product_code WHERE a.sp_chinh_yn = 1 GROUP BY a.machine_code, a.create_date) r LEFT JOIN public.mflist_line l ON l.line_code = r.machine_code LEFT JOIN (SELECT machine_code, create_date AS day, sum(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (end_date::timestamp + end_time::time - create_date::timestamp - create_time::time)) / 60.0) AS stop_minutes FROM public.mes_oi_stop_line WHERE end_date IS NOT NULL AND end_date >= create_date AND end_date > '1900-01-01' GROUP BY machine_code, create_date) st ON st.machine_code = r.machine_code AND st.day = r.day JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR coalesce(u.ds_branchs, '') = '' OR coalesce(l.branch_code, '001') = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')))

mes_material_usage.title: Cấp và tiêu hao nguyên vật liệu sản xuất (mes_oi_material)
mes_material_usage.source_sql: SELECT a.machine_code AS machine, coalesce(a.production_order, '') AS work_order, a.product_code AS product, coalesce(vp.ten_vt, '') AS product_name, a.material_code AS material, coalesce(NULLIF(a.material_name, ''), vm.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, coalesce(NULLIF(a.dvt, ''), vm.dvt, '') AS unit, a.create_date AS day, coalesce(a.so_luong_can_cap, 0) AS required_qty, coalesce(a.so_luong, 0) AS issued_qty, coalesce(a.sl_su_dung, 0) AS used_qty, coalesce(a.sl_con_lai, 0) AS remaining_qty, coalesce(a.sl_chenh_lech, 0) AS variance_qty, a.id_material AS feed_id FROM public.mes_oi_material a LEFT JOIN public.dmvt vp ON vp.ma_vt = a.product_code LEFT JOIN public.dmvt vm ON vm.ma_vt = a.material_code CROSS JOIN public.userinfo u WHERE u.user_id = %s

mold_cavity_specs.title: Liên kết Khuôn - Sản phẩm - Cavity - Chu kỳ - Tuổi thọ shot
mold_cavity_specs.notes: Bảng danh mục khuôn; không yêu cầu lọc ngày. Dùng max trên total_shots/warranty_shots/cavity để không cộng trùng qua các mã con.
mold_cavity_specs.source_sql: SELECT h.ma_khuon AS mold, coalesce(h.ten_khuon, '') AS mold_name, s.ma_sp AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, coalesce(s.id_cap, '') AS cavity_group, coalesce(s.chinh_phu::text, '') AS primary_flag, coalesce(s.cavity, h.so_cavity, 0) AS cavity, coalesce(s.chu_ki, 0) AS cycle_sec, coalesce(h.tong_so_shot, 0) AS total_shots, coalesce(h.so_shot_bh, 0) AS warranty_shots, (coalesce(h.so_shot_bh, 0) - coalesce(h.tong_so_shot, 0)) AS remaining_warranty_shots, s.ln AS line_id FROM public.dmhosokhuon h JOIN public.dmhosokhuonsp s ON s.ma_khuon = h.ma_khuon LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = s.ma_sp JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR coalesce(u.ds_branchs, '') = '' OR coalesce(h.branch_code, '001') = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')))

production_forecast_demand.title: Nhu cầu giao hàng PO & Dự báo FCST (snapshot mới nhất mfkhsx_po_fc)
production_forecast_demand.notes: Chỉ lấy snapshot tính toán mới nhất (max(date0)) để tránh cộng trùng giữa các ngày chạy MRP; lọc day theo ngày giao hàng (ngay_giao_hang). Với câu hỏi nhu cầu/FCST tương lai không nêu tháng cụ thể, lọc day từ ngày hiện tại (today) đến +365 ngày; nếu mã biến thể có hậu tố trả 0 dòng, thử lọc material bằng op='contains' theo mã gốc.
production_forecast_demand.source_sql: SELECT f.ma_vt AS material, coalesce(v.ten_vt, '') AS material_name, coalesce(f.ma_kh, '') AS customer, coalesce(k.ten_kh, '') AS customer_name, coalesce(f.loai_du_lieu, '') AS demand_type, coalesce(f.nguon_du_lieu, '') AS data_source, coalesce(f.model, '') AS model, f.ngay_giao_hang AS day, coalesce(v.dvt, 'PCS') AS unit, coalesce(f.so_luong, 0) AS quantity, f.id AS line_id FROM public.mfkhsx_po_fc f LEFT JOIN public.dmkh k ON k.ma_kh = f.ma_kh LEFT JOIN public.dmvt v ON v.ma_vt = f.ma_vt CROSS JOIN public.userinfo u WHERE u.user_id = %s AND f.date0 = (SELECT max(date0) FROM public.mfkhsx_po_fc)

gl_account_movements.title: Phát sinh sổ cái & công nợ kế toán (ct00 / dmtk0)
gl_account_movements.notes: Chỉ gồm các dòng có phát sinh tiền khác 0. Trong CSDL ERP hiện tại, ct00 chỉ có số tiền phát sinh đến 2024-09-06 và bảng số dư đầu kỳ cdkh/cdtk đang trống (0 dòng).
gl_account_movements.source_sql: SELECT trim(coalesce(c.tk, '')) AS account, coalesce(t.ten_tk, '') AS account_name, trim(coalesce(c.tk_du, '')) AS offset_account, trim(coalesce(c.ma_kh, '')) AS partner, coalesce(k.ten_kh, '') AS partner_name, trim(coalesce(c.ma_ct, '')) AS doc_type, trim(coalesce(c.ma_nt, '')) AS currency, c.ngay_ct AS day, coalesce(c.ps_no, 0) AS debit_vnd, coalesce(c.ps_co, 0) AS credit_vnd, coalesce(c.ps_no_nt, 0) AS debit_orig, coalesce(c.ps_co_nt, 0) AS credit_orig, c.stt_rec AS doc_id FROM public.ct00 c LEFT JOIN public.dmtk0 t ON t.tk = c.tk LEFT JOIN public.dmkh k ON k.ma_kh = c.ma_kh JOIN public.userinfo u ON u.user_id = %s WHERE (coalesce(c.ps_no, 0) <> 0 OR coalesce(c.ps_co, 0) <> 0 OR coalesce(c.ps_no_nt, 0) <> 0 OR coalesce(c.ps_co_nt, 0) <> 0) AND (coalesce(u.is_super, 0) = 1 OR coalesce(u.ds_branchs, '') = '' OR c.ma_dvcs = ANY(string_to_array(coalesce(u.ds_branchs, ''), ',')))
